lead: `Core\Path::split` keeps `.` and `..` as elements, so `join` of its result is not the normal form.
body: Resolving them is `normalize`'s job alone, so the round trip is an identity only *through* the normal form and exact only on a path that is already normal. Assert `normalize(join(split($p))) == normalize($p)`, never `join(split($p)) == normalize($p)`, which fails on ordinary rows.
